automotive_doppler_main.description: Automotive triangular-modulation radar odometry benchmark from Table I. KITTI relative translation and rotation errors are reported for sequence classes with increasing geometric difficulty.

avg_translation_error_pct.description: Average KITTI-style relative translation error across the automotive sequence groups.

avg_rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: Average KITTI-style relative rotation error across the automotive sequence groups.

automotive_ablation.description: Ablation study from Table II on the proposed automotive setup, excluding Skyway. Metrics average Suburbs, Highway, and Tunnel KITTI errors plus velocity RMSE.

avg_translation_error_pct.description: Average KITTI-style relative translation error for the automotive ablation setting.

avg_rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: Average KITTI-style relative rotation error for the automotive ablation setting.

velocity_rmse_mps.description: Root mean squared body-velocity error in meters per second.

boreas_leaderboard.description: Boreas SE(2) odometry leaderboard results from Table III for sawtooth-modulation public automotive radar sequences.

translation_error_pct.description: KITTI-style relative translation error on the Boreas leaderboard sequences.

rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: KITTI-style relative rotation error on the Boreas leaderboard sequences.

mulran_public.description: MulRan average KITTI odometry errors from Table IV across KAIST, DCC, and Riverside sequence groups.

avg_translation_error_pct.description: Average KITTI-style relative translation error across the MulRan sequence groups.

avg_rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: Average KITTI-style relative rotation error across the MulRan sequence groups.

offroad_rpe.description: Off-road mobile robot relative position error from Table V across Parking, Industrial, Grass, and Woods environments.

avg_rpe_pct.description: Average relative position error on the off-road sequence groups.

synthetic_doppler_core.description: Scaled replacement benchmark (paper's Doppler-enabled automotive data is not public): six held-out procedurally rendered spinning-FMCW radar sequences (three landmark-rich, three featureless-tunnel), 72 scans each, vehicles start from rest with time-varying speed and yaw rate. Values are the reference reproduction's held-out scores, not paper-reported numbers. Comparator rows are frozen by the evaluator.

avg_translation_error_pct.description: Mean KITTI-style relative translation error (%): segment-start-frame relative displacement error over 20/35/50 m segments divided by segment length, averaged per sequence then over sequences.

avg_rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: Mean KITTI-style relative heading error in degrees per 100 m over the same segments.

endpoint_position_error_m.description: Final-position drift in metres, expressed in the first-pose frame (alignment-free).

path_length_error_pct.description: Absolute mismatch of total travelled distance as a percentage of the ground-truth path length.

synthetic_doppler_structured.description: Landmark-rich held-out sequences of the scaled replacement benchmark (buildings with gaps, poles, clutter). Values are the reference reproduction's held-out scores, not paper-reported numbers.

translation_error_pct.description: KITTI-style relative translation error (%) over 20/35/50 m segments, averaged over the sequences of this scene type.

rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: KITTI-style relative heading error in degrees per 100 m for this scene type.

endpoint_position_error_m.description: Final-position drift in metres, expressed in the first-pose frame (alignment-free).

path_length_error_pct.description: Absolute mismatch of total travelled distance as a percentage of the ground-truth path length.

synthetic_doppler_tunnel.description: Feature-degenerate held-out sequences of the scaled replacement benchmark (two dense smooth walls extending beyond radar range at both ends). Values are the reference reproduction's held-out scores, not paper-reported numbers.

translation_error_pct.description: KITTI-style relative translation error (%) over 20/35/50 m segments, averaged over the sequences of this scene type.

rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: KITTI-style relative heading error in degrees per 100 m for this scene type.

endpoint_position_error_m.description: Final-position drift in metres, expressed in the first-pose frame (alignment-free).

path_length_error_pct.description: Absolute mismatch of total travelled distance as a percentage of the ground-truth path length.

synthetic_doppler_ablation.description: Aggregate held-out odometry of the scaled replacement benchmark plus body-frame velocity RMSE (vector norm, per scan). Values are the reference reproduction's held-out scores, not paper-reported numbers.

avg_translation_error_pct.description: Mean KITTI-style relative translation error (%): segment-start-frame relative displacement error over 20/35/50 m segments divided by segment length, averaged per sequence then over sequences.

avg_rotation_error_deg_per_100m.description: Mean KITTI-style relative heading error in degrees per 100 m over the same segments.

velocity_rmse_mps.description: Root mean squared vector error of the reported per-scan body-frame velocity in m/s.

endpoint_position_error_m.description: Final-position drift in metres, expressed in the first-pose frame (alignment-free).

path_length_error_pct.description: Absolute mismatch of total travelled distance as a percentage of the ground-truth path length.
